Package com.eqixiac.equinix

package com.eqixiac.equinix
Root package for the Equinix Java SDK. Contains the main entry point classes for each supported Equinix platform domain: Fabric, NetworkEdge, CustomerPortal, IBXSmartView, InternetAccess, and Projects. Each entry point extends EquinixClient and provides lazy-initialized accessor methods for domain-specific resource clients.
